title: Bell and Well
author: Rafael Coldharbour
blurb: Casper Almeida, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
